title: Unique gluing effect of ASXL1 K351 monoubiquitination stimulates the PR-DUB activity.
authors: Zhang, Tianyi; Zheng, Jiqing; Tong, Zebing; Deng, Zhiheng; He, Zaozhen; Wu, Xiangwei; Wang, Miao; Du, Yunxiang; Xu, Ziyu; Tao, Shixian; Wan, Shizhang; Tian, Xiaolin; Deng, Haiteng; Pan, Man; Ai, Huasong; Liu, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ASXL1 K351单泛素化通过分子胶效应稳定PR-DUB催化口袋并激活去泛素化酶活性，涉及蛋白质-DNA（核小体）互作与分子动力学模拟，但核心是泛素化调控酶活而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Protein ubiquitination critically regulates biological processes through both proteolytic and nonproteolytic mechanisms. While classically known for protein degradation, ubiquitination also modulates enzymatic activity. However, current mechanisms of ubiquitination-mediated enzymatic modulation are spatially constrained near enzyme-substrate interfaces. Here, we report a unique ubiquitination-mediated regulatory paradigm that activates the Polycomb repressive deubiquitinase (PR-DUB) complex from a site distal to the enzyme-substrate interface. We found that ASXL1 K351 monoubiquitination promotes nucleosomal H2AK119Ub deubiquitination by stabilizing the PR-DUB catalytic pocket, thereby increasing catalytic velocity (V(max)) without affecting substrate affinity (K(m)). Structurally, ubiquitin at ASXL1 K351 bridges the BAP1 and ASXL1 subunits, functioning as a cross-bracing 'glue' that constrains their conformational dynamics without altering the nucleosome-binding interface. Molecular dynamics and hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry revealed that this modification locks PR-DUB in a catalytic state poised for substrate cleavage. This study reveals a unique ubiquitin function of intersubunit fastening through a molecular glue effect and clarifies the mechanism of PR-DUB activation.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质泛素化通过蛋白水解和非蛋白水解机制关键性地调控生物过程。尽管经典上以蛋白质降解著称，泛素化也调节酶活性。然而，目前泛素化介导的酶调节机制在空间上受限于酶-底物界面附近。在此，我们报道了一种独特的泛素化介导的调控范式，该范式从远离酶-底物界面的位点激活Polycomb抑制性去泛素化酶（PR-DUB）复合物。我们发现ASXL1 K351单泛素化通过稳定PR-DUB催化口袋促进核小体H2AK119Ub去泛素化，从而增加催化速率（V(max)）而不影响底物亲和力（K(m)）。结构上，ASXL1 K351处的泛素桥接BAP1和ASXL1亚基，作为交叉支撑的“胶水”限制其构象动态，而不改变核小体结合界面。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和氢-氘交换质谱（hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry）揭示该修饰将PR-DUB锁定在适于底物切割的催化状态。本研究揭示了泛素通过分子胶效应实现亚基间紧固的独特功能，并阐明了PR-DUB激活的机制。
